title: Opening of the interview at Crawford's Bronx home
summary: Crouch opens the Smithsonian interview, giving the date and place, and Crawford jokes about starting at the beginning.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places

blocks.x: MR. CROUCH: Interview with Mr. Jimmy Crawford, February 12th, 1978, at his home, 3240 Maryland Avenue in the West Bronx.
Okay. Now, Mr. Crawford, since this interview is supposed to deal with your life and career as a musician, I think we should start --
Well, I don't -- is it necessary to call your name?
Do what you want to do.
